உறுமிடும் ஒரு யாளி ஆகும்

I need to set it straight, 
Never gonna settle,
I’m bringing the venom
When I’d be there villainous,
Gotta be killing ‘em,

About to go win it,

Chopping their heads
And I’m making it mine,
When I’m raking the truth

Nobody stopping it,
Taking ‘em on
I’m ready for the fight

let the people hear of my kindgdom come 
yeah they breaking me tearing me see me fall below
let the bloodstains fall watch it all burn down 
cant touch me, but you can see me
paint their walls red dipped in the blood of my foes 
its a fever im a dreamer watch me make it all go

Taking back the throne right at dawn

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: RAMAYANA Trailer Reaction! | Ranbir Kapoor | Yash | Sai Pallavi | Namit Malhotra
snippet.description:
Jaby and Achara react to the breathtaking Ramayana trailer, an awe-inspiring glimpse into one of India's greatest epics brought to life on an unprecedented cinematic scale. Showcasing stunning visuals, emotionally charged moments, epic battles, and a powerful score, the trailer raises the excitement even further as it teases the timeless journey of Lord Ram, the rise of Ravana, and the ultimate clash between dharma and adharma. Every frame promises a visually spectacular and emotionally unforgettable theatrical experience.

The film features an extraordinary cast including Ranbir Kapoor (Brahmāstra, Sanju), Sai Pallavi (Premam, Love Story), Yash (KGF, Toxic), Sunny Deol (Gadar, Border), and Ravi Dubey (Jamai Raja, Matsya Kaand), with visionary producer Namit Malhotra leading this ambitious adaptation. The epic is further elevated by the legendary musical collaboration of Hans Zimmer and A. R. Rahman, creating one of the most anticipated cinematic events in Indian cinema.

There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: WICKER | Official UK Trailer
snippet.description:
On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

WICKER in cinemas October 30th.

https://www.pcgamer.com/games/action/peak-dev-would-rather-you-pirate-peak-than-play-a-microtransaction-roblox-slop-ripoff/

-----

Depending on what you actually count as a “video game” the industry is now generating somewhere between 200 and 350 billion dollars a year in annual revenue, making it by far the largest entertainment sector in the world regardless of whatever your exact definitions may be.  
More people are playing video games than ever before, they are playing them for longer, and (the not so secret reality is that) video game companies have gotten a lot better at getting money out of them while they are.
Over what should have been the best half decade in the history of the industry, the overall market is down by as much as 30% from its peak, in the same time that the broader market has more than doubled. 
Sooo how is it possible that even with record sales, record new revenue streams, record numbers of new players, and record new opportunities to monetize that new audience… video game companies have still managed to screw this up so badly?

Transfers look like they have a lot more clauses which is great and a lot more realistic hopefully they exist for players at the start

Jamal moosiala being with 183 million was great vvd being worth 16 is crazy low I think FC27 wow

Increase transfer activity isn't actually that good news but it could be good.

snippet.description:

Collect a cast of charming Monsters with a passion for song in the award-winning My Singing Monsters! Download for free: https://bigbl.be/PlayMySingingMonsters
Breed and feed hundreds of quirky musical Monsters with their own unique sounds to form a furry and feathery orchestra. Then place your Monsters on beautifully decorated and fully-customizable Islands to create catchy tunes that you’ll be singing along to in no time! With so many Monsters to collect, you’ll be addicted to this monstrously fun game before you know it.

FEATURES:
• Over 400 unique monsters to collect, nurture, and love
• Amazing art, animation, and audio effects
• Lush islands, each with its own musical theme
• Dozens of wacky decorations and structures
• Built-in social features and activities
• New and exciting content is always in the works!

The unique musical world of My Singing Monsters would not be possible without the hard work and dedication of the Monster-Handler Team. From the fantastical designs provided by Art and Animation, to the iconic sounds and scores from the Audio Team, this musical menagerie is built on the shared work of many. Special thanks to the design, production & programming teams, marketing & promotions, testing & support, and to everyone Big Blue Bubble who make My Singing Monsters possible.

#MySingingMonsters
